newsitem.title: USA: NeoStar unable to get financing, may sell assets.
newsitem.headline: NeoStar unable to get financing, may sell assets.

text.p: NeoStar Retail Group Inc on Monday said that discussions between its lenders and a stockholder aimed at arranging financing, have ended and that the firm will seek permission to auction its assets.
NeoStar said its debtor-in-possession lenders and Leonard Riggio, a director and shareholder, failed to reach an agreement on the terms of a financing transaction.
The firm said it is seeking U.S. Bankrupcy Court authorization to proceed with the auction plan, and vendors have been notified to stop shipping new inventory.
NeoStar, a retail computer software concern, operates in the U.S. and Canada under the names Babbage's and Software Etc.
